title: Lookah Unicorn 2.0 eRig Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Lookah Unicorn 2.0 E Rig is yet another portable dab rig made by Lookah. This device comes with two distinct coils, giving you the freedom to tailor your vaporizing experience according to your specific needs. It’s powered by a 1900 mAh battery charged via Micro USB, ensuring you can enjoy multiple sessions on a single charge. Its three voltage settings offer control over your vapor’s intensity.

Product Features:
Quartz hive coil
Quartz cup coil
LED Indicators
Single-button operation
Micro-USB Charging
3 Temperature Settings(10W,16W,19W)

What’s Included:
1 Silicone Mouthpiece
1 Unicron 2.0
1 USB Cable
1 Cleaning Brush
1 Cleaning Tool
2 Hive Quartz Coil
